'''2011 Bespin Regionals Devin Aue LS Naboo''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Devin Aue]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo|Cor-L-naboo.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Devin Awe
* '''Deck name:''' Night of the Living Gungans
* '''Username:''' Devin Awe
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
